applied.problem: "Settings that never swing past rest" is not a property of a damping value: an overdamped or critical mass given a push towards rest can cross it once; and "gets back"/"without overshoot" overstate what decays never quite reach. Narrowed to "do not ring" and "settles".
Screen 7 says the equal roots at −2 are "the furthest from zero two real roots can be", which is false: at damping 6 the fast root is −5.24. Only the slow root is as far from zero as it can get.
